title: Per-bug PASS/FAIL ledger (G1-G6 gate scaffold output)
description: Closed-object schema for the per-bug PASS/FAIL ledger emitted by the pillar4 G1-G6 gate scaffold's `simbench_bw_gates --evaluate` CLI. Each cell records a (bug_id, kernel_slug, variant_id) triple plus per-gate verdicts and cluster-bootstrapped 95% confidence intervals computed at the pre-registered N_boot. The provenance discipline is enforced at three levels: every input fingerprint carries `data_provenance`; every per-cell entry copies that provenance label; every aggregate cell is stratified by provenance. An aggregate that combines synthetic and measured per-cell results without per-provenance stratification is rejected with `gate_aggregate_provenance_mixed`. Synthetic-only success on the gate scaffold MUST NOT be cited in any identifiability claim.

n_boot.description: Cluster-bootstrap iteration count. Frozen at the pre-registered N_boot=10000 by default.

frozen_seed_ref.description: Repo-relative path to the frozen `pre_registration_seeds.toml` from which the bootstrap RNG seed is sourced. Bootstrap outputs computed without sourcing the frozen seed fail the replay-checksum check.

aggregate_results.description: Aggregate cells stratified by data_provenance. For every aggregate dimension (cross-kernel, cross-bug, cross-variant), a separate aggregate cell is emitted per provenance class; mixing classes triggers `gate_aggregate_provenance_mixed`.

gate_label.description: Pillar4 gate identifier. Each gate is the canonical scaffold gate published in the pre-registered gate specification TOML.

metric_value.description: Underlying metric value (e.g. MAPE in percent for G1).

z_score_3sigma.description: Per-cell three-sigma z-score from pillar4 gate G3. Reported alongside MCC-corrected significance per the dual-threshold framing.

aggregate_key.description: Aggregate-dimension key value (e.g. a kernel slug for `cross_variant` aggregation, a bug_id for `cross_kernel` aggregation).
